subtitle: Reverse-chronological flight record. Green markers are production milestones — code that reached real users. Cyan markers are platform and architecture work that made the next launch possible.

readouts: Architected 12-module Clean Architecture and cut cold-start latency 38% (1.42s → 0.88s) using Baseline Profiles with Macrobenchmark gates in CI.
Built an offline-first reconciliation layer on Room + transactional outbox reaching 99.98% successful sync across unstable 3G/4G uplinks.
Authored Compose stability guidelines and automated ktlint/detekt/coverage gates, collapsing PR review cycles from 3 days to under 4 hours.
Migrated a legacy RxJava/XML codebase to Coroutines and Jetpack Compose without freezing the product roadmap.
Built a hardware-accelerated rendering pipeline for GTFS-Realtime maps, holding 60fps through rush-hour density at 2.4M daily events.
Engineered SQLCipher-encrypted storage and biometric auth for POS terminals clearing 100k+ transactions per month.
Shipped 15+ native Android applications to Google Play across commerce, streaming, tracking, and utility categories.
Authored a reusable networking and offline-caching core adopted by 6 client project teams, removing duplicated boilerplate.
Mentored 4 junior engineers on lifecycle management, LeakCanary triage, and JUnit/MockK test design.
